text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
From the 4th corner into the long, long 
homestretch!! Who will become the Queen of 
the Oaks?!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —Haaaahhh!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I won't give it up!! This Oaks, no matter 
what—)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Not yet!!!!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: —HAAAAAAAAAHHH!!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ngh...!! No way—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye takes the lead!! What 
incredible strength!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Almond Eye crosses the finish line!! 2,400 
meters was no problem at all!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I did it...!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Seriously...!? Burst of speed like that 
over 2400 meters is insane...!? She's in a 
whole different league...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
She was super cool~! She's totally gonna 
win the Shuka Sho too at this rate...! I'm 
definitely cheering for her!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (Why...?! Why did I lose...?!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(The distance was completely in my favor! 
The strategy was spot on too, so why...!!)
âLala!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Ai-san... Congratulations.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. That was truly a wonderful 
race...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
You really are strong. All the way to the 
very end, I felt your running so 
intensely, it was almost frightening...!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the next Shuka Sho 
as well! I'll definitely win again!!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: (...This is it—)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Before speed, or technique, or any of 
that... It was her sheer unyielding spirit 
that beat me.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Ai-san bridged the gap in raw talent 
today through sheer unyielding fighting 
spirit alone.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(And next time, I'm sure she'll overcome 
all sorts of things with her sheer 
grit...)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Endlessly, on and on until she wins. 
That's the scariest thing about this girl. 
But――)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —I ain't gonna lose, no way.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I've got my pride too, y'know. The pride 
of a Junior-class Queen.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"At the Shuka Sho, things won't go like 
they did today."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Shall we settle this?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's the spirit, Lara. I'm really 
looking forward to our match!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: —My apologies.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...Today's race. I was completely bested 
by Ai-san's unyielding spirit."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"I had more base stamina to begin with, no 
doubt about it. But—"

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"With that competitive spirit and pure 
grit, Ai-san overcame the gap and 
shattered my strategy."

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
And unable to take any suboptimal 
measures, I was forced to fight on 
Ai-san's ideal terms...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
It's all down to my carelessness. And my 
slowness in making a decision.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I let the title of Queen of the Oaks slip 
right through my fingers... It's so 
frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...In the upcoming Shuka Sho. I will claim 
victory there, without fail. So please—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to your continued guidance 
and support.

The light in Lucky Lilac's eyes is strong. 
Already harboring a quiet fighting spirit 
for her next race, they sparkle with 
dignified resolve.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Wait... What's this all of a sudden?
choice_data_list:
I thought it was behavior befitting a 
queen.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...If that's the case, Trainer, please 
keep standing proudly beside me from now 
on.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
After all, we're the duo that won the URA 
Best Dresser Award.

I puff out my chest. As the trainer of a 
queen, I must stand tall and proud, 
without a trace of shame.

And with that, we reset our mindset. 
Aiming for the final crown, the Shuka Sho—

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Finally, next is the final Tiara, the 
2000m turf 'Shuka Sho' at Kyoto...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(I'll show 'em I can win...! If it's me 
and Trainer, we can do it...!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Once more, please don't hold back 
as we head toward the Shuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"With that fighting spirit, Ai-san will 
definitely be my greatest rival next time, 
too. ...I've gotta work desperately to 
catch up."
choice_data_list: Yeah, let's be sure to catch up!

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text: Yes. Let's do our best.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
Ah, no. ...I just thought my shoelaces 
were a bit loose. Must've been imagining 
things.

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...There's no pain. And it doesn't feel 
like fatigue either.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(Even so, just now... my body felt kind of 
weird... like it was tensing up.)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
(...If this keeps happening, I should talk 
to Trainer. For now, I'll just keep an eye 
on it—)

As the days leading up to the Shuka Sho 
began, a faint presence was quietly 
emerging—
